text: {"label": "Problem Behavior and Health in Developmental Disabilities","definition": "Assessment and treatment of challenging behavior, along with promotion of health, adaptive behavior, and quality of life, for children and adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centers on problem behavior assessment, treatment, and health or quality of life, not communication systems and social interaction, school-based academic instruction, or older mental-retardation-era research."}
